Metadata.title: Proyecto Semilla: Secure, AI-first multitenant SaaS boilerplate

Hero.title: Launch your SaaS in days, not months
Hero.description: Proyecto Semilla is a secure, AI-first multitenant SaaS boilerplate with authentication, roles, billing, and internationalization ready out of the box.

About.title: About the Project
About.subtitle: An open foundation for your next SaaS
About.description: Proyecto Semilla is an open, production-ready starting point for building multitenant SaaS products. It ships with authentication, organizations, roles and permissions, Stripe billing, and AI-first tooling so you can focus on what makes your product unique.

agents.title: AI-First Development
agents.description: Build faster with AI-assisted workflows and Model Context Protocol integration baked into the stack.

labs.title: Multitenant Core
labs.description: Organizations, roles and permissions, Stripe billing, and audit logs ready out of the box.

steps.title: Clone & Run
steps.desc: Clone the repository and bring the whole stack up with Docker in minutes.

steps.title: Customize
steps.desc: Adjust branding, modules, and plans to match your product.

steps.title: Launch
steps.desc: Deploy a secure, multitenant SaaS and start onboarding customers.
